Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

Nossos benefícios são flexíveis e você poderá distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades e interesses:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens)
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Meu Pet Club
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível)
  • Reembolso Flex (óculos, vacinas, educação e outros)
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação

Bem-estar: VT, Birthday off, Gympass, Licença Maternidade de 180 dias e Licença Paternidade de 30 dias, além de auxílio creche no primeiro ano do bebê.

Sobre a vaga:

Habilidades Técnicas Essenciais

  • Processamento de faturas e pagamentos
  • Conciliação financeira e contábil
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP
  • Excel intermediário a avançado
  • Noções de contabilidade

Habilidades Comportamentais Valorizadas

  • Profissional se adapte rapidamente e contribua com fluidez ao time
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência
  • Boa comunicação
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Resiliência e adaptabilidade
  • Comprometimento com prazos e qualidade

♿ Vaga também para PcD

SOMOS DIFERENTES DE TUDO O QUE VOCÊ JÁ VIU!

Faça parte da BIP: Um ecossistema inovador, humano, ousado e revolucionário.

Somos uma consultoria internacional de transformação de negócios, fundada na Itália em 2003, há 20 anos impactando milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho.

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.

Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

ESTAMOS PRESENTE EM DIVERSOS LOCAIS DO MUNDO!

+40 países de atuação + 5000 Bipers pelo mundo +700 projetos no mercado

Tudo o que temos e construímos para um futuro que se aproxima, é guiado pelo nosso

PROPÓSITO:

Pursuing Changes, Nurturing Progress

A mudança é a base de nossa mentalidade, aprendemos e reaprendemos constantemente. Somos desafiadores, assumimos o risco de explorar novas formas de tornar as coisas melhores, inovadoras e sustentáveis para nós, para os nossos clientes e para a sociedade a qual pertencemos. Esforçamo-nos para criar o que ainda não existe, bem como para cuidar e fazer crescer o que existe. Não deixamos pedra sobre pedra – isso é o quão longe ousamos ir.

title: Specialist, Americas Payroll
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll join our Americas Payroll team within Finance, where we are responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and compliant payroll operations across the region. In this role, you’ll work closely with colleagues across Payroll, HR, People Operations, Staffing, Recruiting, and Finance to support employees and ensure payroll processes run smoothly across multiple South American countries.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

As a Specialist, Americas Payroll, you will play an important role in supporting payroll operations across South America, including Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, and Peru. You will help ensure payroll is processed accurately and on time, while maintaining compliance with local labor, tax, and social security regulations. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical payroll expertise with a service-oriented mindset and careful attention to detail.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage payroll processing activities across South America, including new hires, terminations, salary changes, benefit deductions, statutory deductions, vacation calculations, and leaves of absence
  • Process payroll elements accurately and within local legal deadlines, including pay rates, deductions, taxes, benefit-related deductions, and time-related data
  • Ensure payroll transactions comply with company policies, local labor laws, tax regulations, and other applicable requirements
  • Partner closely with HR, People Operations, Staffing, and Recruiting teams to support an accurate and timely flow of payroll information
  • Maintain documentation related to payroll changes and support audit requirements across the region
  • Assist in identifying operational risks and strengthening internal controls where needed
  • Work with the Payroll Manager to improve payroll processes, systems, and controls on an ongoing basis
  • Support system upgrades, testing, and process enhancement initiatives related to payroll operations
  • Serve as a main point of contact for employee questions related to payroll
  • Provide clear, timely, and high-quality support to employees across the region
  • Contribute to additional responsibilities and special projects as needed

ABOUT YOU

This opportunity is exclusively open to professionals with disabilities (Pessoa com Deficiência - PCD).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in payroll processing
  • Strong expertise in payroll calculations, with a high level of accuracy and consistent compliance with deadlines
  • Experience supporting compliance with Brazilian labor and payroll legislation, including CLT, collective bargaining agreement or union rules, INSS, FGTS, IRRF, eSocial, DCTFWeb, and other required payroll-related filings
  • Fluency in Spanish, written and verbal;
    English is a plus
  • Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage confidential information with discretion
  • Proficiency in Excel and payroll systems such as ADP eXpert, ADP Celergo, or similar platforms
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and take ownership of deliverables
  • Collaborative approach, positive attitude, and strong sense of accountability

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with payroll taxes and labor regulations across multiple South American countries
  • Exposure to regional or global payroll environments
  • Knowledge of accounting principles and accounting systems
  • Experience with Workday

title: Parts Inventory Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

The Parts Inventory Manager is responsible for managing spare parts and component inventory across multiple Vammo locations. This role ensures accurate stock control for electrical motorcycles, BBoxes, batteries, and related components.

The position leads the inventory team, maintains accurate data in the Warehouse Management System (WMS), and guarantees that physical stock matches system records through regular cycle counts and inventory audits. The role works closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and After-Sales teams to ensure parts availability and operational efficiency.

Key responsibilities include supervising inventory operations, managing stock levels across sites, implementing inventory control processes, and ensuring reliable reporting and traceability of all parts movements.

Hard Skills

  • Inventory management and stock control
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  • Cycle counting and physical inventory audits
  • Inventory reconciliation and discrepancy analysis
  • Supply chain and logistics processes
  • Data analysis and reporting (Excel / ERP / dashboards)
  • Multi-site inventory management
  • Demand planning and stock level optimization
  • Process implementation and standardization
  • Cost optimization in inventory and logistics
  • Experience with motorcycle components and electronic parts.

Soft Skills

  • Leadership and team management
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Problem-solving mindset
  • Attention to detail
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Communication skills
  • Process improvement mindset
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Hands-on mentality ("mão na massa") – willing to dive into operations when needed

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Sobre a Vaga

O Gerente de Estoque é responsável por gerenciar o estoque de peças e componentes em diferentes locais da Vammo. Essa função garante o controle preciso do estoque de motocicletas elétricas, BBoxes, baterias e seus respectivos componentes.

A posição lidera o time de inventário, mantém informações precisas no WMS (Warehouse Management System) e garante que o estoque físico esteja alinhado com os registros do sistema por meio de contagens cíclicas e auditorias de inventário. Essa função trabalha em conjunto com as áreas de Supply Chain, Procurement, Operações e Pós-Vendas para garantir disponibilidade de peças e eficiência operacional.

As principais responsabilidades incluem supervisionar as operações de inventário, gerenciar níveis de estoque em diferentes sites, implementar processos de controle de estoque e garantir relatórios confiáveis e rastreabilidade de todas as movimentações de peças.

Hard Skills

  • Inventory management and stock control
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  • Cycle counting and physical inventory audits
  • Inventory reconciliation and discrepancy analysis
  • Supply chain and logistics processes
  • Data analysis and reporting (Excel / ERP / dashboards)
  • Multi-site inventory management
  • Demand planning and stock level optimization
  • Process implementation and standardization
  • Cost optimization in inventory and logistics
  • Experience with motorcycle components and electronic parts.

Soft Skills

  • Liderança e gestão de equipe
  • Forte organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Mentalidade de resolução de problemas
  • Atenção a detalhes
  • Colaboração entre áreas
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico
  • Senso de dono e responsabilidade
  • Mentalidade “mão na massa” – disposição para se envolver diretamente nas operações quando necessário.

title: Manufacturing Quality And Aftersales Specialist
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role:

As a Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist, you will play a vital role in our commitment to implementing best practices in quality control. This position is dedicated to ensuring the highest quality standards in our products through collaboration with suppliers, monitoring quality processes, and enhancing our aftersales services. Your contributions will not only enhance our products and services but also strengthen positive relationships with our customers. Job Description:

  • Collaborate with suppliers to establish clear quality expectations and standards for components and materials.
  • Evaluate suppliers reports to ensure compliance with quality standards and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor the quality processes for incoming materials, documenting and analyzing relevant data and processes.
  • Manage warranty processes with suppliers, including the preparation and submission of technical reports, claims, and supporting documentation.
  • Create detailed re ports on product quality metrics and supplier performance, identifying trends and opportunities for enhancement.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to communicate findings and recommend actions that improve product quality and customer satisfaction.

Hard Skills:

  • Experience in quality assurance, supplier management, or a related field within manufacturing or the automotive industry.
  • Proficiency in quality management systems and reporting tools that facilitate effective data analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess product performance and identify recurring quality issues.
  • Advanced English proficiency for effective drafting and communication.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly Disciplined: Demonstrates a strong commitment to accuracy, organization, and consistency in all tasks.
  • Process-Oriented Thinking: Employs systematic thinking to analyze workflows and enhance problem-solving capabilities, ensuring efficiency in processes.
  • Attention to Detail: Conducts thorough evaluations of supplier quality and product performance, focusing on delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Effective Communication Skills: Communicates clearly and concisely with stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual understanding across teams.

title: Senior Portfolio Manager
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay, our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for a Senior Portfolio Manager to take end-to-end ownership of portfolio performance and Cost of Risk outcomes. This position reports directly to the Head of Risk.

You will steer portfolio mix and concentration risk, continuously improve provisioning and loss forecasting accuracy, and design risk-adjusted pricing frameworks that enable disciplined but ambitious GTM growth. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct commercial impact and close collaboration across GTM, Treasury, and Collections.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio management, or structured lending
  • Advanced SQL required;
    Python strongly preferred
  • Proven ownership of Cost of Risk (CoR) and portfolio performance
  • Strong understanding of credit cycles, concentration risk, and sector deterioration
  • Hands-on experience with provisioning models (e.G., IFRS9) and expected loss methodologies
  • Experience building risk-adjusted pricing frameworks
  • Strong commercial judgment — able to enable growth while protecting downside risk
  • Experience working closely with collections or recovery teams
  • Clear communicator, able to translate portfolio insights into business steering decisions
  • Experience with structured vehicles (e.G., FIDC) preferred

Responsibilities

  • Own portfolio steering across channels, sectors, ratings, and accounts
  • Monitor large exposures and concentration risk
  • Steer origination mix to balance growth and profitability
  • Deliver Cost of Risk in line or better than budget
  • Own and improve provisioning logic and expected loss methodologies
  • Reduce variance between expected and realised losses
  • Work closely with Collections to incorporate recovery insights into forecasting assumptions
  • Own risk-adjusted pricing logic for new and existing proposals
  • Partner with GTM to structure commercially competitive yet disciplined offers
  • Build scalable pricing and steering tooling to support faster decision-making
  • Align portfolio strategy with treasury constraints and capital efficiency

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Warehouse Assistant- Talent Pipeline
description:
Note: We’re proactively identifying strong profiles for future openings. This position is not immediately available.

OUR MISSION

At Evernex, we believe millions of IT parts thrown away each year deserve a second life. That’s why we step in and give them a new purpose. From hospitals to banks to airports, we ensure critical systems stay operational while helping businesses reduce costs and minimize environmental impact.

With teams across the world — from Paris to Melbourne, Dubai to São Paulo, Casablanca to Kuala Lumpur — we are building a future where IT is greener, smarter, and more sustainable. How does that sound to you?

More information is available at

Why this role matters

As our Stock Keeper in Brazil , you play a key role in ensuring that our logistics operations run smoothly and efficiently.

You are responsible for managing warehouse operations, ensuring spare parts and equipment are received, stored, and dispatched accurately and on time. Your work directly supports business continuity for our customers across the region.

You will independently manage the warehouse and ensure that all logistics processes align with Evernex standards and policies.

✨ How will you make an impact?

Our Stock Keeper ensures that warehouse operations are organized, compliant, and efficient — supporting both internal teams and external partners.

You are responsible for, but not limited to:

  • Managing warehouse operations in compliance with Evernex policies and vision.
  • Overseeing receiving, storage, inventory control, and dispatch activities.
  • Monitoring stock levels and ensuring accurate inventory management.
  • Producing regular reports (IN/OUT status, dead stock, inventory accuracy, etc.).
  • Coordinating with clients, suppliers, transport companies, and internal teams.
  • Ensuring proper space management and warehouse organization.
  • Inspecting tools and equipment and overseeing general maintenance.
  • Monitoring service quality and responding to operational feedback.
  • Ensuring warehouse productivity targets are achieved.

This is an individual contributor role — no team management is involved.

What makes you a great fit

We’re looking for someone who combines operational discipline, organization, and accountability.

Ideally you:

  • Have proven experience in stock keeping or warehouse operations.
  • Understand warehouse procedures and best practices.
  • Have hands-on experience with warehouse management systems and databases.
  • Demonstrate strong organizational and reporting skills.
  • Are comfortable working independently and taking full ownership of warehouse activities.
  • Communicate effectively with suppliers, transport partners, and internal teams.
  • Speak Portuguese, English and Spanish fluently.

Certifications in Warehouse Management, Logistics, or equivalent experience are preferred.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Join Evernex and you’ll contribute to meaningful global operations that support sustainable IT lifecycle management.

We keep things collaborative and people focused — less hierarchy, more teamwork. You’ll find trust, flexibility, and the opportunity to take ownership of your role.

And along the way, you will:

  • Work for a global leader in sustainable IT solutions.
  • Be part of a multicultural and fast-paced environment.
  • Grow through continuous learning and development opportunities.
  • Contribute to a greener and more responsible IT industry.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner (Customer Experience)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Finance Business Partner to support our rapidly growing Customer Service platform across multiple countries. This role sits at the intersection of finance and operations, acting as a strategic advisor to business leaders while ensuring strong financial governance, scalable processes, and disciplined cost management.

The ideal candidate brings deep Finance BP experience, thrives in fast-paced environments, and demonstrates strong business acumen — particularly within customer-centric or service-driven organizations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Finance Partnership: Partner closely with the multi-country Customer Service leadership team to drive financial planning, improve decision-making, and embed financial discipline into daily operations.
  • Financial Process Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve financial processes, policies, and controls. Provide expert guidance to support sustainable and compliant business growth.
  • Market Expansion Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries or cities by establishing scalable frameworks, ensuring operational continuity, and proactively mitigating financial risks.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work in close partnership with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls teams to ensure regulatory compliance and alignment with corporate standards.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Leadership: Own the annual budgeting cycle and rolling forecasts for the Customer Experience (CE) business. Build a robust budget management structure and partner with stakeholders to drive accountability and financial performance.
  • Advanced Financial Analysis: Develop a comprehensive financial analysis framework to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver actionable insights — with a strong focus on cost efficiency and operational productivity within customer service environments.
  • Data & Financial Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and digital tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that enhance visibility and decision support.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Proven exposure to multi-country or regional operations .
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to translate financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities and proficiency with financial and data analysis tools.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience managing finance for customer service, contact centers, shared services, or operations-heavy businesses .
  • Background in multinational or high-growth technology, e-commerce, logistics, or platform companies.

Why Join Us

  • Scale with a high-growth global business: Play a key role in supporting rapidly expanding international operations.
  • True business exposure: Operate as a strategic partner with direct impact on operational and financial outcomes.
  • Broad finance scope: Gain hands-on experience across multiple finance disciplines while shaping scalable frameworks for the future.
  • High visibility: Collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence critical business decisions.

title: Finance Business Partner (Marketing)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven Finance Business Partner to support strategic business initiatives and international expansion. This role will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, ensuring financial rigor while enabling fast, sustainable growth.

You will operate at the intersection of finance and strategy — shaping investment decisions, strengthening financial governance, and delivering insights that directly influence business performance.

This position is ideal for finance professionals who combine strong analytical capabilities with a commercial mindset and thrive in dynamic, high-growth environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Financial Partnership: Partner with business leaders across the full financial lifecycle — from planning to execution — providing actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making.
  • Financial Governance & Process Excellence: Design, implement, and continuously optimize financial processes, policies, and controls to enhance operational efficiency while ensuring compliance.
  • Expansion & Market Launch Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries and cities by establishing scalable frameworks, enabling operational continuity, and proactively managing financial risks.
  • Investment Evaluation & Business Case Development: Assess new business opportunities by evaluating investment requirements, expected returns, and financial viability. Provide clear recommendations to support strategic growth initiatives.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Ownership: Drive the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts, partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure disciplined financial management and strong resource allocation.
  • Advanced Business Analysis: Build robust financial analysis models to monitor performance, identify opportunities, highlight risks, and guide leadership on profitability and cost optimization.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and corporate standards.
  • Finance Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that improve transparency and decision support.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Robust experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Solid knowledge of financial regulations within Brazil .
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in financial systems and data analysis tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience in high-growth industries such as technology, e-commerce, logistics, on-demand platforms, or internet companies .

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a rapidly scaling global business with significant international growth ambitions.
  • Operate as a strategic partner , influencing key investment and operational decisions.
  • Gain broad exposure across financial disciplines while supporting complex, cross-border initiatives.
  • High-impact role with strong visibility among senior stakeholders.

title: Salesforce Analyst
description:
Job Title : RevOps Analyst

Location : Hybrid (Batel, Curitiba, 3 days in-office – 2 days remote)

Employment Type : Full-Time

Mission: Why we exist, What we do and Why we need you

RevBlack exists to revolutionize revenue operations, turning CRM systems into engines of growth and efficiency. We specialize in optimizing Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and RevOps using tools like HubSpot and Salesforce to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions for our clients.

RevBlack is not for everyone. It’s for the curious, fast learners who take ownership and thrive on high standards. We work hard, move fast, and deliver work that makes a difference. If you’re seeking an easy job, this isn’t it. But if you’re ready to push your limits and grow, we want you.

We need a RevOps Analyst to drive client success by implementing CRM solutions, optimizing processes, and providing insights that fuel revenue growth. You will apply your technical and analytical skills in the fast-paced world of SaaS and B2B operations. You'll become specialists in Salesforce and HubSpot to streamline workflows, support data-driven decisions, and drive both operational efficiency and client success.

What you’ll own

  • Drive Client Revenue Growth: Implement and manage CRM solutions that lead to measurable revenue increases.
  • Optimize Operational Processes: Streamline revenue operations to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Maintain Data Integrity: Ensure CRM data accuracy for informed decision-making.
  • Provide Strategic Recommendations: Analyze data to offer insights that boost client success.

What we’re looking for.

  • CRM Experience: Experience or strong interest in RevOps, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, CRM Administration, or a related professional services delivery role.
  • Operational Expertise : Deep knowledge of sales, marketing, and customer success operations.
  • Analytical Prowess: Strong skills in data analysis and process optimization.
  • Business Knowledge: Strong business acumen with an understanding of the SaaS business model and B2B environments.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and a willingness to deepen technical knowledge.

Why Join RevBlack?

  • Be part of a dynamic and innovative team that delivers high-quality, impactful work tailored to our clients' needs.
  • Enjoy a flexible work environment with a hybrid modality, competitive salary, and benefits like unlimited PTO.
  • Take advantage of significant opportunities for career growth, with a strong focus on continuous learning and skill development.
  • Work in a transparent and communicative culture where clarity and collaboration are key to success.

If you’re ready to make a difference in the RevOps world, apply now to join RevBlack.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to design, build, and optimize modern web applications using WebView, .NET, Docker, Azure Cloud, and MongoDB/SQL. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with strong backend and frontend development experience, cloud expertise, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Advanced English proficiency is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full‑stack applications using .NET and modern frontend technologies.
  • Build and enhance WebView-based interfaces for seamless embedded web experiences.
  • Develop scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices architecture.
  • Containerize applications and manage deployments using Docker.
  • Deploy, monitor, and optimize solutions in Azure Cloud (App Services, Functions, DevOps, Containers, etc.).
  • Work with both MongoDB and SQL databases, ensuring high performance and data integrity.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including product, QA, UX, and architecture.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, security, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Troubleshoot issues across the application stack and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Document architecture, technical decisions, and system processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong professional experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Strong proficiency in .NET / .NET Core development.
  • Experience with WebView (Hybrid apps, embedded browser frameworks, or similar technologies).
  • Solid experience with Docker for containerization and deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud (Web Apps, Azure Functions, Storage, Container Registry, DevOps or ARM/Bicep).
  • Strong knowledge of MongoDB and SQL databases (queries, indexing, performance tuning).
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, design patterns, and clean architecture.
  • Advanced English (verbal and written).

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture.
  • Familiarity with API gateways, authentication frameworks, and cloud security best practices.
  • Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).
  • CI/CD setup experience (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar).
  • Knowledge of front-end frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue) is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality delivery.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Analista De Melhoria Contínua E Sgi Pl
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. title: Executivo De Vendas Externas - Máquina De Cartão - Mercado Pago - Sp - Piracicaba/Sp

title: Analista De Infraestrutura Jr.

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. title: Senior Specialist - Strategy, New Business And Corporate Planning
description:
A Stellantis é uma das maiores montadoras do mundo, resultado da fusão entre a Fiat Chrysler Automobiles (FCA) e o Groupe PSA. Possuindo uma ampla presença global, atuando em mais de 130 países e com 300.000 colaboradores. O grupo tem como objetivo tornar-se líder em eletrificação, com planos para investir 30 bilhões de euros em veículos elétricos e híbridos.

Esta posição atua na interseção entre estratégia, inovação e desenvolvimento de novos negócios dentro da Stellantis na América do Sul. A posição oferece alta exposição à liderança da companhia e a oportunidade de trabalhar em iniciativas que contribuirão para moldar o futuro da mobilidade e o crescimento de longo prazo da Stellantis.

Áreas de Impacto

1. Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis (H)

Monitorar tendências de mercado, concorrência, tecnologias emergentes e mudanças regulatórias, identificando oportunidades e riscos relevantes para o negócio.

2. Alinhamento Estratégico e Recomendação Executiva (H)

Avaliar oportunidades à luz da estratégia corporativa, conectando iniciativas regionais às diretrizes globais e estruturando recomendações para a liderança.

3. Novos Modelos de Negócio e Parcerias Estratégicas (H)

Desenvolver estudos estratégicos, análises de viabilidade e business cases para novos negócios, parcerias e investimentos, em colaboração com stakeholders internos e externos.

4. Suporte a Fóruns e Governança Estratégica (M)

Preparar materiais executivos e análises de alto nível para suportar fóruns estratégicos e processos decisórios.

Principais Responsabilidades

- Definir abordagens analíticas e premissas estratégicas para avaliação de oportunidades e construção de business cases.

- Avaliar, priorizar e aprofundar oportunidades de novos negócios e parcerias com base em impacto estratégico e geração de valor.

- Estruturar cenários, análises de risco e alternativas estratégicas para suporte à tomada de decisão.

- Elaborar materiais executivos (apresentações, análises e reports) para fóruns internos e interações com stakeholders externos.

- Atuar em interface contínua com áreas internas e parceiros externos para coleta de informações, alinhamento e desenvolvimento de iniciativas.

- Contribuir para o alinhamento entre iniciativas regionais e diretrizes globais da companhia.

Requisitos

- Pensamento estratégico e resolução estruturada de problemas, com capacidade de atuar em contextos complexos e ambíguos.

- Autonomia e senso de dono na condução de análises e projetos estratégicos, do diagnóstico à recomendação.

- Proatividade e curiosidade intelectual para identificar oportunidades, antecipar tendências e propor soluções de valor.

- Comunicação clara e capacidade de influência para atuar com múltiplos stakeholders em ambientes multifuncionais.

- Habilidade de traduzir análises complexas em recomendações estratégicas acionáveis para a liderança.

- Experiência prévia em Strategy, Business Development, Corporate Planning, Consulting ou Corporate Finance.

- Vivência na condução de análises estratégicas, construção de business cases e avaliação de novos negócios.

- Experiência na gestão de projetos estratégicos complexos, com interação transversal e múltiplos stakeholders.

- Atuação próxima à liderança executiva, incluindo preparação de materiais e suporte à tomada de decisão.

Diferenciais:

- Experiência no setor automotivo ou mobilidade

- Espanhol fluente

- Pós-graduação

Na Stellantis, avaliamos os candidatos com base em qualificações, mérito e necessidades do negócio. Acolhemos candidaturas de pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, idade, etnia, nacionalidade, religião, orientação sexual e deficiência. A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. title: Desenvolvedor(A) Full Stack Sênior - Ia/Llm
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para atuar na construção de aplicações com IA/LLMs em produção, com foco em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e integrações com serviços de inferência (model serving).

A pessoa irá desenvolver soluções ponta a ponta utilizando .NET (C#) no backend, Angular no frontend, Python para rotinas de IA e pipelines, além de SQL Server e bases vetoriais para persistência e busca semântica. O objetivo é entregar produtos robustos, com qualidade, segurança e boa experiência para o usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades full stack com IA: chat corporativo, busca semântica, assistentes e copilotos;
  • Implementar eevoluir pipelines de RAG: ingestão, chunking, embeddings, indexação e retrieval
  • Integrar aplicações com LLMs via API/endpoint e/ou servidores/plataformas de inferência;
  • Construir APIs e serviços em .NET (C#) para integração com LLMs, RAG e sistemas internos
  • Implementar UI em Angular (streaming de resposta, histórico, feedback do usuário, filtros e controles)
  • Desenvolver rotinas/serviços em Python para ingestão, geração de embeddings e automações
  • Trabalhar com SQL Server e bases vetoriais (indexação e busca por similaridade com metadados)
  • Implementar tratamento de erros, resiliência (timeouts/retry) e controles operacionais
  • Atuar com segurança e governança (autenticação, autorização, trilhas e privacidade/LGPD)
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de engenharia (testes, code review, versionamento e CI/CD)

✅ Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack em produção
  • .NET (C#) para APIs/serviços (REST, autenticação/autorização, integrações)
  • Angular (componentização, consumo de APIs, estado e performance)
  • Python para rotinas de IA/integração (scripts, serviços leves, consumo de APIs)
  • SQL Server (modelagem, queries e performance básica)

Experiência prática com LLMs em produção:

  • Consumo via API/endpoint, streaming, controle de contexto e custos
  • Noções de validação/guardrails (entrada/saída, políticas e limites)

Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) em projeto real:

  • Ingestão, embeddings, indexação e retrieval (com filtros por metadados quando necessário)

Experiência com base vetorial / busca semântica:

  • pgvector, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate ou Qdrant (ou equivalente)

Experiência com inferência/model serving:

  • Integração/uso de pelo menos um: vLLM, TGI, Ollama, llama.Cpp, Triton ou endpoint gerenciado
  • Noções de latência, concorrência e timeouts

Memória de longo prazo em aplicações com LLMs (nível sênior):

  • Persistência de histórico, preferências e contexto com critérios de retenção e privacidade
  • Armazenamento/recuperação em SQL e/ou base vetorial

Boas práticas de engenharia:

  • Git, testes, code review, CI/CD e Docker (quando aplicável)

⭐ Diferenciais:

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol): uso/integração de MCP servers para conectar LLMs a ferramentas e dados corporativos
  • Experiência com Bamboo (Atlassian) para CI/CD
  • Observabilidade avançada (dashboards, tracing, métricas de latência e qualidade)
  • Kubernetes e estratégias de autoscaling
  • Avaliação avançada de RAG/LLM (testes automatizados, datasets, A/B, quality gates)
  • Noções de fine-tuning / LoRA / PEFT (não obrigatório)

title: Network Engineer
description:
Network Engineer – LAN/WAN (Senior / Level 3)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer (LAN/WAN) to join our global infrastructure team. In this role, you will design, deploy, and maintain complex network environments while providing advanced Level 3 support for critical incidents. You will work closely with cross‑functional teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure high availability, security, and performance across enterprise network systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy LAN/WAN network infrastructure across enterprise environments.
  • Provide 3rd level troubleshooting for all LAN/WAN issues, alerts, and escalations.
  • Maintain and support all network monitoring and reporting systems .
  • Produce and maintain detailed technical documentation for all deployed systems and solutions.
  • Participate in on‑call rotations and provide after‑hours support as required.
  • Perform administrative tasks including time reporting and status updates.
  • Configure and install a wide range of network components (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, QoS).
  • Execute network maintenance, upgrades, patches, hotfixes, and security configurations.
  • Monitor network performance, ensuring system availability, reliability, and capacity planning .
  • Follow established change and configuration management processes for all network modifications.
  • Work with the security team to implement security tools, policies, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with vendors and internal IT teams to resolve complex issues.
  • Deliver technical training to internal teams.

Technical Qualifications

  • Strong networking background with CCNP certification (required) .
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to quickly diagnose and repair network issues.
  • Ability to communicate with customers, gather requirements, and collaborate with offshore teams.
  • Experience with SD‑WAN (Silver Peak preferred) .
  • Experience with Next‑Gen Firewalls (Cisco Firepower preferred) .
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting routing loops, asymmetric routing, and STP loop issues.
  • Expertise configuring/troubleshooting:
  • Cisco ASA, IPS
  • Cisco ISE
  • Cisco WLC (wireless)
  • Routing protocols: EIGRP, OSPF, BGP
  • LAN switching: VLAN, VTP, STP, EtherChannel
  • Quality of Service (QoS)
  • TCP/IP stack
  • Application protocols: FTP, SMTP, SNMP, SSL, etc.
  • Network security: IPSec/SSL VPN, Cisco AnyConnect, AAA, TACACS+, RADIUS, 802.1x
  • Experience with Cisco Catalyst and Nexus 7K/9K switches .
  • Skilled in Cisco IOS and NX‑OS configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with application load balancers and firewall cloud services ( Zscaler preferred ).
  • Data Center networking experience ( Nexus / ACI preferred ).
  • Ability to support enterprise apps such as SAP, Citrix, Portal, etc.
  • Ability to analyze monitoring outputs and recommend actions (e.G., CPU spikes on core devices).
  • Cloud experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with Citrix NetScaler, Cisco FTD, Aruba SD‑WAN, and Azure Cloud considered a strong advantage.

General Qualifications

  • Strong team player with excellent collaboration skills.
  • Ability to interact directly with end users to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.
  • Self‑starter with strong initiative and problem‑solving mindset.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation abilities.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly in a dynamic environment.

Education Requirements

  • CCNP Certification (required)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • Advanced English.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Tech Especialista Em Engenharia De Dados
description:
A missão do Especialista em Engenharia de Dados será atuar na arquitetura, construção e evolução do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados desenvolvidos pelo time, incluindo soluções de Analytics, agentes e modelos de machine learning.

Trabalhará em conjunto com outro especialista de engenharia de dados na definição e implementação de arquiteturas, modelagem e disponibilização de dados em ambientes distribuídos, utilizando tecnologias como AWS, Spark, Trino e Athena, além de viabilizar o consumo eficiente dessas informações por ferramentas como o Metabase.

Será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados, garantindo performance, escalabilidade, qualidade e governança das informações. Espera-se que o profissional atue com alta autonomia técnica, contribuindo para decisões de arquitetura e para a evolução contínua do ecossistema de dados, assegurando que as soluções atendam às necessidades analíticas e de inteligência dos produtos com robustez e confiabilidade.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar na construção e evolução da arquitetura do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados do time (Analytics, agentes e modelos);
  • Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e confiáveis em ambiente AWS;
  • Modelar e estruturar dados para consumo analítico e operacional, garantindo qualidade, performance e governança;
  • Definir padrões, arquiteturas e boas práticas de dados;
  • Implementar eotimizar consultas e camadas de acesso a dados utilizando Athena e Trino;
  • Processar e transformar grandes volumes de dados utilizando Spark;
  • Garantir a disponibilização eficiente de datasets para consumo em ferramentas analíticas como Metabase;
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, queries e tabelas no Data Lake;
  • Assegurar qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados ao longo de todo o pipeline;
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias de particionamento, versionamento e organização de dados;
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e evolução das boas práticas de engenharia de dados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor melhorias contínuas no ecossistema de dados e nas tecnologias

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados em larga escala;

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

O que você deve ter?

- Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID;

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde;

Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Home Office;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions.

title: Assistente De Manutenção
description:
Resumo das atividades

Foco em Manutenção Residencial .

  • Executar manutenção corretiva elétrica, mecânica e hidráulica em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, atendendo solicitações internas e de moradores, diagnosticando defeitos, através de manuais, desenhos e/ou avaliação técnica, substituindo peças e efetuando os ajustes necessários;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva (mecânica, elétrica e hidráulica) baseando-se em checklist, inspecionando equipamentos de sistemas de refrigeração, funcionamento de bombas, caixa d’água, parte elétrica, geradores etc., detectando possíveis irregularidades, executando os reparos e informando o superior sobre os problemas detectados;
  • Utilizar, ferramentas e equipamentos apropriados para cada tipo de atividade, inclusive trabalhos em altura, fazendo uso dos acessórios de segurança exigidos, conforme legislação vigente;
  • Cuidar da segurança dos usuários, residentes e funcionários, durante a execução dos serviços de manutenção;
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos moradores e demais usuários, realizando manutenção corretiva/preventiva nos apartamentos;
  • Acompanhar leitura e registrar o consumo diário de gás, água e energia;
  • Inspecionar os equipamentos de combate a incêndio;
  • Solicitar e acompanhar visita técnica e manutenção realizada por terceiros;
  • Cumprir procedimentos relativos ao uso de EPI e EPC;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados nos serviços de manutenção, requisitando sua reposição quando necessário;
  • Orientar profissionais de menor nível de experiência assim como fornecedores;
  • Executar pequenos serviços de alvenaria e marcenaria, quando necessário;
  • Registrar as manutenções efetuadas e todos os atendimentos realizados a moradores;
  • Executar outras atribuições correlatas de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Liderar e coordenar equipe de brigadistas, realizar ações de treinamento e procedimentos para o Edifício.
  • Controlar o estoque de materiais, peças, componentes, ferramentas e equipamentos, verificando quantidades e registrando em documentos e planilhas sua movimentação;

Qualificação

Ensino médio completo;

Desejável superior ou técnico em elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, hidráulica;

Curso de NR10.

Habilidades

Capacidade resolutiva;

Comunicar-se deforma inclusiva e eficaz diante um público multicultural e amplamente conectado;

Organização para arquivar informações de maneira correta;

Proatividade emexecutar as manutenções.

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

Horário de trabalho:

  • De segunda à sexta-feira

title: Product Designer - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Genial Investimentos é uma das maiores plataformas de investimentos do Brasil. Com mais de 2 milhões de clientes, estamos presentes em todo o país por meio de nossos escritórios e assessores parceiros.

Nascemos com um propósito claro: democratizar o acesso ao mercado financeiro , oferecendo produtos, serviços e tecnologia de ponta para todos os perfis de investidor — do iniciante ao profissional.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo que vai de renda fixa, ações, fundos de investimento, previdência e fundos imobiliários , até soluções de serviços bancários digitais , como conta com Pix, cartão de crédito e pagamentos integrados. Também desenvolvemos soluções sob medida para empresas, como Genial As a Service , que oferece infraestrutura bancária via API.

Mais do que uma plataforma, somos parceiros na construção de um futuro financeiro mais próspero, transparente e acessível.

Quer conhecer mais sobre a Genial? Acesse:

#VemSerGenial

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Buscamos um Product Designer Pleno capaz de transformar problemas complexos em experiências simples, intuitivas e de alto impacto para o usuário e para o negócio.

Procuramos alguém com forte vivência em craft, pensamento estruturado e visão orientada a impacto, alguém que se motiva por criar soluções digitais, relevantes e escaláveis.

Estamos em um momento estratégico na Genial, com muitos desafios, autonomia e espaço real para construir. Se você quer crescer, aprender rápido e contribuir ativamente para o futuro do mercado financeiro, essa vaga é para você.

  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de design de produto : descoberta, definição de problema, ideação, prototipação, testes, handoff e acompanhamento pós-implementação;
  • Conduzir fluxos e jornadas de ponta a ponta dentro do squad, com autonomia para planejar, priorizar e validar soluções;
  • Colaborar de forma próxima e contínua com PMs, engenheiros, researchers e stakeholders, garantindo alinhamento e clareza nas decisões;
  • Criar interfaces e fluxos com alto padrão de craft , consistência visual e atenção ao detalhe;
  • Validar hipóteses por meio de protótipos realistas e testes com usuários, reduzindo incertezas e acelerando aprendizados;
  • Monitorar e medir o impacto de suas entregas em métricas de usabilidade, comportamento e negócio;
  • Participar decritiques, rituais do time e iniciativas que fortaleçam a prática de design na Genial.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em design de produtos digitais , com portfólio que demonstre raciocínio estruturado, craft de qualidade e impacto em resultados;
  • Capacidade deresolver problemas de média a alta complexidade , navegando bem entre discovery e delivery;
  • Boa comunicação, com habilidade para defender soluções, explicar raciocínios e influenciar decisões;
  • Clareza analítica e rigor na estruturação de problemas e hipóteses;
  • Criatividade orientada a impacto — pensar fora da caixa com responsabilidade;
  • Perfil altamente colaborativo, com facilidade para trabalhar em squads multidisciplinares;
  • Atenção a detalhes e cuidado com consistência, acessibilidade e qualidade final do produto;
  • Desejável: experiência com produtos financeiros ou ambientes regulados.

Informações adicionais

Nosso escritório fica localizado em São Paulo na Av. Faria Lima 3.400

title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
Netcracker Shaping the Digital Future

As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. We combine an open Agentic AI Platform with AI-Native IT Solutions to help telecommunication providers transform, innovate, and deliver results that matter. Powered by cutting-edge technology—and the passion of our people—we unlock new opportunities, spark innovation, and create better digital experiences for millions worldwide. Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future—we’re leading it.

About the role

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

Required Experience

  • 3 or more years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode

Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Técnico De Elevadores ( Experiência Com Elevadores A Tração)
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Alimak Group é um fornecedor global de soluções sustentáveis de acesso vertical e trabalho em altura para os setores comercial, industrial e da construção. Com presença em mais de 120 países, o Grupo desenvolve, fabrica, comercializa e presta serviços de soluções de acesso vertical e trabalho em altura, com foco em agregar valor ao cliente por meio de maior segurança, maior produtividade e melhoria da eficiência de custos.

O Grupo possui uma ampla base instalada de elevadores, elevadores de serviço, guindastes e plataformas temporários e permanentes, bem como unidades de manutenção predial em todo o mundo. O portfólio de soluções também compreende equipamentos de proteção contra quedas, medição e controle de carga, içamento e manuseio, além de um modelo global de pós-venda, com receita recorrente de peças de reposição e serviços, como inspeção, certificação, manutenção, reformas, substituições e treinamento.

Fundado na Suécia em 1948, o Grupo tem a sede em Estocolmo, 26 fábricas e unidades de montagem em 15 países e aproximadamente 3.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Na Alimak Group, entendemos que nossos colaboradores são a chave para o nosso sucesso. Nosso objetivo é ser um Empregador de referência atraente, e nos empenhamos em atrair, desenvolver e reter pessoas qualificadas e motivadas, em um ambiente de trabalho profissional e atrativo.

Trabalhar na Alimak Group significa fazer parte de uma equipe de profissionais que trabalham juntos para promover inovação e as melhores práticas em soluções de acesso vertical.

Nossa divisão industrial está contratando 2 técnicos, RESIDENTES DA GRANDE SÃO PAULO, para se juntarem ao nosso grupo conforme descrito abaixo.

Sobre o Cargo:

TÉCNICO DE SERVIÇOS

Resumo das atribuições:

  • Realizar inspeções periódicas para detectar possíveis falhas nos ELEVADORES Alimak;
  • Realizar manutenções preventivas/corretivas dos equipamentos e maquinários para acesso vertical comercializados (ELEVADORES);

Requisitos:

  • Certificação técnica em mecânica ou área correlata;
  • Conhecimento sobre a instalação, operação e reparo de ELEVADORES RESIDENCIAIS;
  • Experiência comprovada no segmento de manutenção e instalação de elevadores, elevadores de serviço, guindastes e plataformas temporários e permanentes, proteção contra quedas, medição e controle de carga, içamento e manuseio.
  • Disponibilidade para viajar;
  • Experiência com instalação, montagem e/ou manutenção de ELEVADORES DE CARGA/PESSOAS com tecnologia avançada;
  • Domínio em mecânica e bons conhecimentos em painéis elétricos;
  • Necessário experiência no setor de Elevadores tipo Pinhão/Cremalheira e Tração
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar externo/em campo com flexibilidade para as mobilizações necessárias dentro da América do Sul;
  • Habilidade para trabalhos em altura;
  • Ler, interpretar procedimentos e instruções técnicas;
  • Flexibilidadepara trabalhar em dias e horários conforme demandado pelos clientes.

Requisitos Complementares

  • Experiência anterior comprovada no setor de Elevadores tipo Pinhão/Cremalheira e Tração em indústrias e/ou plataformas offshore.
  • Ensino técnico completo em áreas correlatas;
  • Disposição para trabalhar viajando, com flexibilidade de horários e de agenda;
  • Conhecimento básico em Microsoft Office necessários para operar dispositivos móveis;
  • CNH Ativa;

title: Talent Acquisition Analyst (Temporary Contract)
description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

As a member of the talent acquisition team, you'll have the opportunity to work in a cross-regional team with international exposure. We spot, engage and hire the top talents to join DiDi. We drive new growth opportunities for our teams by running talent programs, where our employees can expand their horizons globally.

In this role you will be...

  • Responsible to manage the full end-to-end hiring cycle for roles across multiple teams in the organization.
  • Acting as a strategic partner to business leaders;
    providing world-class market information, talent intelligence and key practices.
  • Owning the overall candidate experience through the hiring process until onboarding.
  • Using data to make decisions that facilitate hiring and allows the organization to make the best hiring decision.
  • Working with other HR teams to drive efficiencies and process improvements.
  • Working in projects that impact how we shape a culture of recruiting.

We are eager to be in touch with you because you have...

  • 1-2 years of experience in recruiting (preferably in a fast-paced environment such as the internet or consulting companies).
  • Experience using ATS systems (lever, greenhouse, icims, etc).
  • Strong verbal and written communication in English and spanish.
  • Excited about driving change and helping the organization evolve.
  • Knowledgeable about talent acquisition techniques (offer negotiation, sourcing, etc).

You‘ll love working at DiDi because:

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday;
it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).
